answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a proof-of-reserves vertex in a shared double-entry ledger, where every new account must post a bonded balance reconciled against a public mesa of attested reserves. Colluding clusters that inflate phantom balances are flagged when forensic reconciliation reveals the same funding dune, since shared origin. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
